name: com.letisim/retail
description: Travel eSIM for 100+ countries: search plans for a destination, get the exact current price and hand off to a first-party Letisim checkout. The server never asks for card data, email or activation secrets.

environmentVariables.name: LETISIM_MCP_ATTRIBUTION
environmentVariables.description: Partner handle of this installation, promo:CODE or ref:slug, issued in the Letisim affiliate cabinet. Purchases started by this installation are credited to that partner. Leave unset for an unattributed installation.

environmentVariables.name: LETISIM_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Letisim API origin. Only needed for local development against a test API.
